newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Xinjiang oil output to top 14 mln T in '96.
newsitem.headline: China's Xinjiang oil output to top 14 mln T in '96.

text.p: China's northwestern region of Xinjiang is expected to produce 14.15 million tonnes of crude oil this year, up 12 percent from 1995, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
Increased production in the region helped make up for declining output of ageing oilfields in the eastern part of the country, the news agency said.
Xinjiang still accounts for only a small portion of China's total oil output which is expected to reach 141 million tonnes this year.
